## What's new
**Know what you approve** - Approvals show the whole command, the diff of an edit or the start of a new file before you allow them. - Risky requests get a red warning: deleting files, force-pushing, `sudo`, running downloaded scripts, editing secrets or files outside the project. - **Always** saves the rule Claude Code suggests (like `Bash(npm test:*)`) so it stops asking. - **OpenCode** requests can now be answered from the notch too.
**Answer Claude's questions in the notch** - When Claude Code asks you to choose, pick an option, tick several or type your own answer, right in the notch.
**Keyboard first** - A global shortcut opens the notch from any app (⌃⌥N by default; change it in Settings → General). - Then ⌘↩ allows, ⌘⇧↩ always allows, ⌘⌫ denies, 1–9 picks an answer and ⎋ closes.
**More in every row** - The git branch, how full the context window is (Claude Code, Codex), and the agent's own to-do progress, like *3/7 · Writing tests*. - A session that has been working without a sound for a while is marked as quiet, so a stuck one is easy to spot and clear.
**When you're away** - Mac notifications and pushes to your phone through ntfy, always or only after you've stepped away. Both are off until you turn them on in Settings → Notifications. - The notch tells you when a plan limit runs low and when it resets.
**Also new** - `crewnotch run npm test` shows any long command in the notch and tells you when it finishes or fails. Install the command in Settings → General. - Recently ended sessions stay at the bottom of the list. **Resume** reopens the conversation in a terminal. - Hide the notch from screen sharing and recordings (Settings → General → Privacy). - A new **Approvals** pane in Settings. Every new feature can be turned off or tuned.

## What's new
- **CrewNotch now updates itself.** It checks for new versions once a day and offers to install them in one click. Turn on "Download and install updates automatically" in Settings → General to skip even that, or check any time with **Check for Updates…**. - Every update is signed and verified before it's installed, and only comes from this project's releases.
